title: Critical Superlatives and Measured Praise
goal: Calibrate praise and critique in formal reviews using relative superlatives + subjunctive, spelling-change -ísimo forms, and sumamente.
grammar: relative superlatives + que + subjunctive, spelling changes in -ísimo (riquísimo, amplísimo), and sumamente + adjective

items: I can pair relative superlatives with que + subjunctive to make sweeping evaluative judgements in a review.
I can form spelling-change absolute superlatives (riquísimo, amplísimo) and calibrate praise with sumamente + adjective.
I can discuss colour, texture, and artistic quality (la paleta, cromático, la textura, el trazo, la maestría, desigual).
